subject: Following up from the website chat — quick demo availability
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Jordan King <jordan@acmeai.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 20:15:00 -0700
Subject: Following up from the website chat — quick demo availability

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for starting a trial and for the chat earlier today. I grabbed your contact info from the widget and wanted to follow up personally. From the transcript it sounds like you’re exploring inference options for conversational features and want to understand cost/latency tradeoffs for a 1–2M monthly active user workload.

Quick ask: are you available for a short 25-minute demo this week so I can show the runtime, batching behavior, and a few pricing/throughput examples tailored to your use case? I suggested a couple of windows below in Pacific time — if none work, reply with two 30-min blocks that do and I’ll get a calendar invite out.

Option A: Tue Apr 13 — 11:00am–11:25am PT (quick walkthrough + Q&A)
Option B: Wed Apr 14 — 2:00pm–2:25pm PT (later slot for your team)

If you prefer self-serve, feel free to pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/karthik-30

I’ve attached the anonymized chat transcript and a short doc with example throughput numbers for similar customers. Monica (CC’d) is our onboarding lead and will join if we get into implementation questions. Priyom is included to help surface any technical artifacts you might want ahead of time.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: chat_transcript_20260411.txt (text), acme-priorities.pdf (pdf)

From: Jordan King <jordan@acmeai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 00:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Following up from the website chat — quick demo availability

Thanks, Karthik — appreciate the follow-up.

A few quick notes: we’re on Pacific time (same timezone) and are targeting a pilot for a search + chat assistant next month. 25 minutes sounds perfect. I’m tied up Tue morning, but Wed 2pm PT would work for me.

Agenda I’d like: a run-through of latency at 512 tokens, how batching affects p50/p95, and any guidance on quantization/FP16 tradeoffs. If you can send a calendar invite with Zoom that’s ideal.

Could you also confirm whether Redwood’s hosted API will preserve request metadata for analytics (we need traceability)? If that’s a long answer, flag Monica to cover it on the call.

Jordan
Director of Product
Acme AI

Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Following up from the website chat — quick demo availability

Perfect — Wed Apr 14, 2:00pm–2:25pm PT is penciled. I’m sending a calendar invite now for a 25-minute slot and will include a Zoom link.

Couple of small asks so the session is high signal:
- If you can share one representative prompt and the expected average response length (tokens) beforehand that would help me tailor the demo.
- If there’s a specific SLA/throughput expectation (e.g., sustained 50 qps with 100ms p50) flag that in reply and I’ll bring fiber to baseline those numbers.

Monica — can you join Wed? Jordan is interested in how we preserve request metadata and auditability for analytics.

Priyom — I’ll loop you if there’s anything architecture-y to prep.

Thanks — invite is on the way.

—
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

One more note: our procurement team is moving quickly and wants a high-level pricing range before the demo (ballpark is fine). If you can provide a single-slide summary or a short note that shows hosted per-token ranges + typical Dedicated reserve breakpoints, that’d be helpful to share internally ahead of the call.

I’ll be on the call with two engineers from my team; Monica, feel free to share a short note about analytics/auditability so we can cover that first. Looking forward to it.

Jordan
